question: Which unit takes the four awesome-tunneling entries that have no egress record: ngrok 1.0 (github.com/inconshreveable/ngrok), Tailcat (tailscale.com/tailcat), Ngrok-operator (github.com/zufardhiyaulhaq/ngrok-operator) and Pomerium (pomerium.com)?
why: A name match of the 156 linked entries of the list against the egress slugs leaves these four with no record; they sit in the open-source and overlay sections, outside the commercial slice 10 to 18 of this unit. ngrok 2.0 is held by egress/ngrok-free, zrok by egress/zrok-hosted, iroh by egress/iroh-public-relay, SSH-J.com by egress/ssh-j.
